name: New Rus 2TC in to Fast Castle - Vlady
author: Azogs_

notes: Build second @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ from @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ if needed. Scout for Deer Packs for @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ placement.
Take all but 4@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and put them on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until 8.

The 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ that aged up will immediately build @building_military/stable.webp@, then to @resource/deer.webp@. Try to push the @resource/deer.webp@ towards @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ with your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@.

Once 8 @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ have finished gathering from the 3@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, send all but one to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. The other will build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ within influence of the Kremlin.
Make  @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ (anywhere from 1-4 depending on matchup), and get @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ whenever you can.
Use your @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ to harass the opponent while you age up to Castle.

Build @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ with 8-12 @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@, depending on how fast you need to get @resource/relics.webp@. Send to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ after.
Send 5@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ for rest of the game.
Get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@. Set @resource/rally.webp@ for @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ to get @resource/relics.webp@.
Immediately queue @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ to get @resource/relics.webp@. Make more @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@.
Send 8@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to a food source, like @resource/deer.webp@. Build a @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@.

If opponent is heavy on @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@. If they are heavy on @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@, make @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@. Make @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ if you need mobility and are ready to micro
Keep producing @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@! You want at least 5 at all times to buff your units and capture sacred sites.

Use your @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ to keep harassing, while massing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ / @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ / @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ and getting all Economic upgrades and @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ upgrades.
Once you're floating around 300@resource/resource_wood.webp@, take some  of those vills and put them on a @resource/resource_food.webp@ source.
Aim to have 10-15 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ at all times, moving any extra to @resource/resource_food.webp@.

Once you've gotten all your @resource/relics.webp@ and capped the @resource/sacred_sites.webp@, take all your @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and put them on either @resource/resource_food.webp@ or @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Build a lot of extra @building_economy/house.webp@ for Kremlin Militia to come out
Use Levy all militia from @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@, and go for timing attack on enemy.

Spend @resource/resource_wood.webp@ on @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@ to protect @resource/resource_gold.webp@, @building_military/barracks.webp@ vs @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ or @building_military/stable.webp@ to raid enemy.

author: Jockxtar

notes: Spend 2 @landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.webp@ tickets to buy @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (force drop @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if necessary)

For example, buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@/@building_rus/fortified-palisade-wall.webp@/@building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@/@building_military/stable.webp@ or @resource/resource_food.webp@ for more units. Or spend excess @resource/resource_gold.webp@ on upgrades.

If opponent goes 2TC: FC @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ -> @resource/relics.webp@, @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@/@unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@/@unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@, Farm transition 20/20/9/3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@repartition
Make sure to secure ahead resources

description:
This is a resume to understand better the new build order for RUS by Swaggy Professor.

Give it a try!
name: Swaggy Brand New RUS Build
author: SnobbyCoder60

notes: Start sending ALL to @resource/resource_food.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@ + queue 2x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ ( + scout around base @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@)

Send 2x @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ each one (the influence of the two areas MUST NOT overlap) + 1x @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@
Retrieve the @resource/sheep.webp@ to the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with the @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@

Leave 4x @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ and move ALL to @resource/resource_wood.webp@+@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ (up to 8). IMPORTANT: let @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ gather ALL the 3x @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ around  @building_economy/town-center.webp@

As soon as the 3x @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ are gathered move 7x @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with the remaining @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ UNDER the @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ area of influence

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ near the @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ with the 5x @age/age_2.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and gather @resource/deer.webp@

Leave on @resource/resource_food.webp@ only the 5x @resource/deer.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and 1-2x @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, then move ALL @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ + get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@
IMMEDIATELY prod. @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/relics.webp@ (starting from the FURTHEST ones)
Build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@+ 3x@building_military/archery-range.webp@ (see notes to understand which units to produce accordingly)

Move 8x@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ on a new @resource/resource_food.webp@ source (can be @resource/deer.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@)

Leave 10-15x @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ + get ALL @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ UPGRADES + ALL @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ UPGRADES + ALL ECONOMIC UPGRADES
Move all @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ whenever gathered 3 or MORE @resource/relics.webp@
